{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Clean the revenue column: remove commas and convert to float
sales['revenue_clean'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)

# Filter out the six QA orders with revenue = 999999.99
real_orders = sales[sales['revenue_clean'] != 999999.99]

# Filter for completed orders only (exclude refunded)
completed_orders = real_orders[real_orders['status'] == 'completed']

# Compute mean revenue of completed orders
mean_revenue = completed_orders['revenue_clean'].mean()

# Print the final value
print(mean_revenue)"}
